question:
If you follow these instructions, do you return to the starting point? Turn around. Turn around. Take 7 steps. Take 6 steps. Take 5 steps.
Options:
- Yes
- No

segments.text: The question is asking if following those instructions brings you back to the starting point.
The instructions are: turn around, turn around, take 7 steps, take 6 steps, take 5 steps.
So if you start facing north, after the first turn you're facing south.
The second turn would make you face north again.
So after two turns, you're back to facing the original direction.
But wait, turning around doesn't change your position, just direction.
So after turning around twice, you're facing the same direction as you started.
Then you take 7 steps forward, then 6, then 5.
So total steps in the direction you're facing would be 7 + 6 +5 = 18 steps.
But since you ended up facing the same direction as you started, you're 18 steps away from the starting point.
